assets.title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
assets.credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio
assets.legend: Flow lines coloured by modelled sea surface temperature: blue 0 C, green 10-20 C, yellow about 25 C, red 32 C. Colorbar file: sst_ecco2_cbar.png
limitations: Flow lines are a rendering; values between model grid points are interpolated.
Equirectangular map: pixel scale varies with latitude.
Covers one modelled year; not a climate trend.
